headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored the winner with 15 seconds remaining to lift the Montreal Canadiens to a 4-3 win over the Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield scores late winner, lifting Canadiens 4-3 over Wild

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel scored two goals to reach 25 for the season and surpass Nikita Kucherov for the team lead as the Tampa Bay Lightning continued their surge with a 4-1 win over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Hagel scores 2 goals to reach 25 as Lightning continue surge with 4-1 win over Sharks

events.name: Ottawa Senators at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Tyler Kleven and Tim Stutzle both scored in the first period, and the Ottawa Senators beat Columbus 4-1 on Thursday night, snapping the Blue Jackets’ four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kleven, Stutzle score early as Senators beat Blue Jackets 4-1

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored two goals, Justin Hryckowian had a goal and two assists, and the Dallas Stars ended a three-game skid while snapping the Boston Bruins' six-game winning streak, 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars end Bruins' 6-game winning streak with a dominant 6-2 victory

headlines.description: — Konsta Helenius scored his first NHL goal, assisted on two others, and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Nashville Predators 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Helenius scores first NHL goal to lead Sabres over Predators 5-3

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele had two goals and an assist to lead the Winnipeg Jets to a 3-1 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele and Morrissey power Jets to a 3-1 victory over the Blues

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Arseny Gritsyuk and Cody Glass each had a goal and an assist and the New Jersey Devils held on to beat the Edmonton Oilers 2-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devils hold off Oilers 2-1, extend perfect record when leading after two periods

events.name: New York Rangers at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Kevin Fiala had a goal and an assist, and Anton Forsberg made 28 saves after taking over for the injured Darcy Kuemper in the Los Angeles Kings' 4-3 victory over the slumping New York Rangers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anton Forsberg excels in relief of injured Darcy Kuemper in LA Kings' 4-3 win over slumping Rangers
